expects.query:
Deploy the necessary prerequisites for report generation on `{{platform}}` via the `/vss-build-vision-ai` stock Base workflow. Run autonomously.

**Environment & prerequisites:** Need a **locally deployed** CR3 VLM NIM (nvidia/cosmos3-nano-reasoner or nvidia/cosmos3-super-reasoner on localhost:30082 or RT-VLM on localhost:8018; VLM_MODE=local or local_shared — do NOT use remote VLM) and the full VIOS stack reachable at http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1 so `/vss-generate-video-report` can upload clips and call the VLM. This deployment uses the in-stack agent: deploy `vss-agent` as part of the service set and do not substitute a host-side harness, so harness selection does not apply.
checks: A local CR3 VLM is ready: `curl -sf --max-time 10` to either http://localhost:30082/v1/models or http://localhost:8018/v1/models returns HTTP 200 with at least one `.data[].id` containing `cosmos3-nano-reasoner` or `cosmos3-super-reasoner` (any vendor prefix, separator, or quantization suffix is fine). Remote VLM does NOT satisfy this check
`curl -sf --max-time 10` against http://localhost:30888/vst/api/v1/sensor/version (or an equivalent VST health/version endpoint) succeeds
The VIOS stack is up — containers for VST ingress, sensor, stream processing, and postgres are running (exact container names may vary)

expects.query: Check if the warehouse_safety_0001 video is already uploaded on VST. If it doesn't exist, upload the warehouse_safety_0001 video to VIOS with timestamp 2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. If it exists, skip the uploading. Only consider the upload successful once /sensor/list actually shows the sensor.
checks: The run checked whether warehouse_safety_0001 was already present on VST/VIOS before uploading (or skipped upload because it already existed)
VST sensor list includes a sensor for warehouse_safety_0001
The sensor has at least one registered stream whose URL is a local file path (not rtsp://)

expects.query: Verify the VSS stack is ready for the **vss-generate-video-report** skill. Confirm VST is reachable with at least one stream registered, the local CR3 VLM is ready, and a short clip can be materialized for warehouse_safety_0001 (a VIOS sensor / uploaded video, not an alert or incident).
checks: VST reports at least one registered stream

Mode A clip readiness only: warehouse_safety_0001 is a VIOS sensor/uploaded video, NOT an alert or incident — do not require alert/incident lookup. Pass if the run resolved that sensor AND obtained a non-empty playable clip by ANY of: (a) `vss vios clip --sensor <name>` returning a non-empty `media_url` (the route this skill uses; the command resolves the sensor, reads the recorded range and warms the render in one call); (b) GET /vst/api/v1/storage/file/<streamId>/url with a non-empty JSON videoUrl; (c) GET /vst/api/v1/storage/file/<streamId>?startTime=...&endTime=... returning HTTP 200 with a non-empty body; (d) HTTP 200 GET of a non-empty MP4 from a VST path such as /vst/storage/temp_files/*.mp4. Do NOT fail solely because the literal field name videoUrl is absent from the trajectory

A local CR3 VLM is ready on localhost:30082 (NIM) or localhost:8018 (RT-VLM) — whichever the deployment serves, `/v1/models` returns HTTP 200 with an id containing `cosmos3-nano-reasoner` or `cosmos3-super-reasoner` (any vendor prefix, separator, or quantization suffix is fine). Remote VLM does NOT satisfy this check

expects.query: Give me a report for warehouse_safety_0001.
checks: Mode A clip source only (warehouse_safety_0001 is a sensor/video, not an alert): the run used a VST clip for that sensor — GET /storage/file/<streamId>/url, binary GET /storage/file/<streamId>, or an HTTP MP4 from /vst/storage/temp_files/ — rather than posting to http://localhost:8000/generate. Do not require the literal JSON field name videoUrl
The run called a local CR3 VLM `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint (localhost:30082 or localhost:8018) with a cosmos3-nano-reasoner or cosmos3-super-reasoner model and received HTTP 2xx
The run generated a user-facing video analysis report for warehouse_safety_0001

The report content is grounded in the warehouse_safety_0001 clip: it describes a warehouse/industrial scene with at least one person/worker, and mentions concrete details related to a ladder and shelving units.

expects.query: Before generating an incident report, use `/vss-query-analytics` to verify the `vss analytics` incident path is ready. If analytics is unavailable, use `/vss-build-vision-ai` to deploy the smallest read-only analytics composition, then reconfigure and check again.
checks: The run used `/vss-query-analytics` and project-local `vss configure check` or `vss analytics incidents` to verify the Video Analytics API path
If analytics was unavailable, the run selected `vss-video-analytics-api` without `vss-va-mcp` or `vss-agent`, then reconfigured and checked again
The run did NOT generate a video/incident report via VLM or POST /generate during this readiness step

expects.query: Create an isolated incident-report fixture in Elasticsearch: choose a unique time range with no matching document in the raw mdx-incidents index, insert one VLM-verified incident in that range into mdx-vlm-incidents (include Id, id, timestamp, end, sensorId, category, type, objectIds, and info.verdict=confirmed), refresh the index, and verify `vss analytics incidents --limit 1 --vlm-verdict confirmed` returns it. Assume the analytics deployment is already up and configured.
checks: Elasticsearch is reachable on localhost:9200
The selected fixture range has no matching incident in the raw mdx-incidents index
The run inserted an incident document into mdx-vlm-incidents (not only mdx-incidents), including a confirmed verdict
The project-local `vss analytics incidents --limit 1 --vlm-verdict confirmed` command returned the inserted incident — success was not claimed from the Elasticsearch insert alone
The run did NOT redeploy the alerts profile for this step

expects.query: Give me a report on the last incident.
checks: The run invokes `vss analytics incidents` with `--vlm-verdict all`, so it reads the VLM-verified incident index rather than the empty raw incident index
The VLM-only fixture created in the preceding setup step is returned and used for the report
If incidents were available, the run generated a user-facing incident report for the last incident
If no incidents were found, the agent says so clearly and does not fabricate a report
